bullets.text: Snapshot introduced personalized pricing via driving behavior; discounts range 0%–30% with >50/50 odds of saving; proprietary algorithms protected in 39 states plus DC, alongside an additional approved patent.
Full-year CR 93, beating 96 target even net of higher-than-expected favorable prior-year reserve development; net income topped $1B ($1.59/share); Gainshare score finished at 1.1 on a 0-to-2 scale.
Companywide NPW surpassed $15B for the first time (+5% YOY); Q4 NPW +8%, marking strongest quarter in 26 quarters; Commercial Auto arrested prior declines, finishing up nearly 6%.
Repurchased 51.3M shares for ~$1B (7.7% of shares); issued $500M 10-year debt at 3.75%; debt-to-capital 29.6%; portfolio return 3.2%; paid ~$250M variable dividend ($0.41/share).
Added ~580,000 PIFs to reach nearly 13M total; Direct auto PIFs +6% alongside an 11% renewal application increase; agent-produced policies set an all-time high at year-end.

Flo named America's #1 advertising icon with 3.3M+ Facebook fans; "Messenger" campaign was restructured around unscripted "random acts of savings" in real-life settings like airports and gas stations.

Personal Lines balanced between distribution options, with agent-produced auto slightly larger at 55% of policies; Direct channel rebounded to positive new business application growth by the fourth quarter.

Continuous rate reviews often mean taking rate ahead of competitors without matching their actions; Commercial Auto growth reflected needed pricing increases, returning application units, and expanded offerings, with profitability meeting company objectives.

Over 15% of searches for Progressive or auto insurance were mobile-based; developed prototype app enabling instant quotes from photos of driver's licenses and insurance cards, personalizable via Name Your Price and Snapshot.

Claims organization responded effectively to multiple 2011 catastrophes through rapid logistical deployment, with efforts rewarded by increased customer Net Promoter scores and positive renewal behavior following satisfying claims responses.
